_method: Real semantic relevance judgment (Claude, this session) over title+abstract, 0-5 scale matching QUAL-SG's own S_t rubric, replacing scripts/rerank.py's keyword-regex relevance_score() for this pool. Judged against the survey's actual 3-subtopic scope (diffusion language models / continual pre-training adaptation / non-autoregressive text generation), scoring off-topic domain applications (protein, RNA, image, video, graph, audio, molecule, mechanical, CAD, recommendation) low even when they use matching keywords like 'discrete diffusion' -- this is the exact failure mode the regex scorer could not catch (see REPORT.md Sec 8, 10).
_index_note: keys are the 0-based index into data/candidates_merged_reranked.json / data/judge_pool.tsv AS OF THIS PIPELINE RUN. Deliberately keyed by index-as-string rather than a flat positional array -- a flat array risks exactly the off-by-N drift bug REPORT.md Sec 4 already documented once for this project; an explicit key:value map fails safe (one wrong score) instead of silently shifting every subsequent score.
_exclusions: index 99 is the anchor paper itself (self-citation via co-citation expansion) -- scored 0 here AND separately hard-filtered by title match in the injection script as a safety net.
